visual_action: A screenshot of a tweet from the account 'FactPost' rotates and zooms into view against a black background. The tweet text discusses an FDA recall of shredded cheese due to metal fragments. Below the text are two images: a close-up of Joe Biden smiling and squinting, and a picture of shredded cheese. The video then cuts to a second image, a meme featuring a photo of Robert F. Kennedy Jr. in front of an American flag with the text 'LISTEN UP LIBERAL' and 'CHEESE METAL'. This image also rotates.

cast.name: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
cast.evidence: A photo of Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is the subject of the final meme, which reads 'LISTEN UP LIBERAL CHEESE METAL'.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: A close-up photo of Joe Biden is featured in the initial tweet screenshot next to a picture of shredded cheese.

cast.name: Food and Drug Administration (FDA)
cast.evidence: The on-screen tweet text states, 'The FDA has recalled over 1 million bags of shredded cheese...'

cast.name: FactPost
cast.evidence: The name 'FactPost' and handle '@factpostnews' are displayed on the tweet screenshot shown in the video.

on_screen_text.text: The FDA has recalled over 1 million bags of shredded cheese due to possible contamination from metal fragments.

spoken_summary: A distorted, reverbed male voice repeats the lyric, "Beefing with my chick while I'm in jail."
audio_music: A repetitive, heavily distorted, and reverbed audio clip from the song 'Beefing With My Chick' by Amilio plays throughout. The effect is chaotic and typical of meme audio.
editing_pacing: The video consists of two static meme images that slowly rotate and zoom, transitioning from one to the next. The pacing is slow and driven by the looping audio.
cultural_references: Memes mocking Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s voice
central_claim: The post mocks Robert F. Kennedy Jr. by using an absurd meme that connects a fake news story about metal in cheese to the nonsensical phrase 'CHEESE METAL,' which is intended to parody his distinctive voice.
intended_effect: To make the audience laugh at and ridicule Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
uncertainty_flags: The 'FactPost' account appears to be a fabricated news source created for the meme.
